response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track AS t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms - b.avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_rate_above_average FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > b.avg_bytes_per_ms

assumptions.assumption: A media type’s bytes per millisecond is its total known bytes divided by the total duration of tracks with known bytes. Average unit price uses all its tracks.

alternatives.interpretation: Bytes per millisecond means the average of each track’s individual bytes-per-millisecond rate.
